review_notes:
I read the whole file (lines 1–88) and the related repo definitions. `SplitPosition` is an abbrev for `PlanarPosition × ℝ`, and `PlanarPosition` is `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)`. The new declarations are `localizedMode`, `localizedPotential` and `splitLaplacian`, plus theorems about them.

The only candidate for a competing concept is `splitLaplacian`, which sums `planarLaplacian` in the planar slice and `deriv (deriv ...)` in the vertical direction. Mathlib has `InnerProductSpace.laplacian` (`Δ`) in `Mathlib/Analysis/InnerProductSpace/Laplacian.lean`, but it needs an inner product space. `Prod` carries the sup norm and has no inner-product instance, so `Δ` doesn't apply directly to `PlanarPosition × ℝ`. The file states that the split Laplacian is deliberately the sum of the planar and vertical derivatives. I found no other Mathlib notion that matches `localizedMode` or `localizedPotential`, which are specific physical modes.

`planarLaplacian` is a hand-rolled Laplacian on `EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin 2)` and could arguably be replaced by Mathlib's `Δ`. It is defined in `PlanarGroundTransform.lean`, outside the target file, so I did not report it. Whether consolidating would pay off is also unclear, because it is used widely across the planar files and I did not trace those uses.

I abstained because the case for consolidation in this file is unclear. I could not run Lean, so I did not check any replacement.
